verdict.rationale: Ollama lets users choose between running models locally, where it claims nothing leaves the machine, and running larger models on Ollama's Cloud. That gives a coarse, device-level choice of where prompts and data reside, but the evidence shows no region or residency selection for the cloud offering. missing for 10: selectable cloud storage/processing regions, documented data-residency guarantees for cloud usage, independent corroboration of local-only data handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
Run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download.
sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models
